verdict.rationale: Glama hosts MCP servers, runs a gateway, and stores chat data, so data region or residency choice is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions choosing a storage region or residency location. The 'private by default' and per-tool access control items are adjacent privacy features, not residency controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
